title: 3Chat 连接配置
description: API Key 仅存储在本机，由 WorkBuddy 在连接 MCP 服务时注入到连接 URL 的 Authorization 参数中，不会上传到云端。
description_en: The API Key is stored locally only. WorkBuddy injects it into the Authorization parameter when connecting to the MCP service and does not upload it to the cloud.
docLabel_en: How to get an Access Token?

fields.label: 3Chat API KEY
fields.placeholder: 登陆 3Chat -> 开放平台 -> OAuth -> 创建并获取 APP KEY
fields.placeholder_en: Log in to 3Chat -> Open Platform -> OAuth -> Create and get an APP KEY
fields.description: 用于访问服务 3Chat 连接器的个人访问令牌。
fields.description_en: A personal access token used to access the 3Chat connector service.
